title: Family-expansion consumer-test adaptation: applicable-trace selection in the four tests/api modules
objective: Adapt the six failing tests in services/api/tests/api/{test_evidence_api,test_rule_evaluation_api,test_scenario_api,test_scenario_analysis_api}.py to the five-member residential_far family that M4-T009 landed: replace single-member assumptions (evaluations[0], len(evaluations)==1, rule_citations[0]) with applicable-trace selection (the trace/group whose applicability_outcome is true - the same idiom the M4-T009 wave already applied to the tests/rules siblings), keeping EVERY value assertion unchanged (behavior-neutral de-brittling; the caps, coverage statuses, citations and provenance expectations stay byte-identical). NO production code change - app/rules/integration.py and app/scenario/builder.py already select applicable traces correctly (verified before contracting). The RED evidence already exists: CI run 34664497740 api job 6 failed/2956 passed at 032dffe7, duplicated in exact-production-install, reproduced locally (6 failed/365 passed in tests/api).
business_reason: The R1-R12 family (M4-T009, gate wave PASS 4-0) cannot be accepted while the api CI job is red from unadapted downstream consumer tests; production behavior is proven correct, so the fix is exactly the test-selection adaptation the family's own packet applied inside its scope but could not apply to tests/api (outside its allowed_paths).

project-control/tasks/M4-T009.json + project-control/reports/M4-T009-G4.md (the tests/rules applicable-trace adaptation idiom this packet mirrors)
services/api/app/rules/integration.py (family evaluation: all members evaluated, applicable traces aggregate)

acceptance_scenarios.input: git diff of the four modules
acceptance_scenarios.expected: every expected VALUE (caps 15000.0/TRACE_CAP, coverage statuses, citation/section texts, provenance refs, disclaimer expectations) is byte-identical before and after; the diff changes only trace/group SELECTION (applicable-trace helpers) and the count assertion's form

selection keys on applicability_outcome is True (or, for evidence rule_citations groups, the group provably tied to the applicable trace), asserts EXACTLY ONE applicable residential_far trace, and fails loudly (not silently index-0) if zero or multiple apply

acceptance_scenarios.expected: the evaluations count is asserted against the document's own family_coverage rule list (or equivalent in-document source), never a hardcoded 5 that rots on the next family expansion

acceptance_scenarios.expected: only the four named modules + producer report change; the full services/api suite passes locally (2962 = 2956 + 6); ruff clean; modularity exit 0

risks: Silent value drift disguised as selection change: S2 exists to force a value-identical diff.
A hardcoded family size (5) that rots on the next expansion: S4 forbids it.
path_notes: EXACT-FILE allowed_paths: the four modules M4-T009's family expansion broke plus this packet's report. services/api/app/** is FORBIDDEN on purpose - production selection logic was verified correct before contracting; if the producer finds a real production defect while adapting, that is a STOP-and-report, never an in-scope fix.
